topic: Dashboards and Metrics Explorer fail to load with generic error after Windows timezone update
environment: Windows update that added new timezones
symptom_pattern: Dashboards and Metrics Explorer fail to load for one user, showing the generic error "Oops, an error has occurred. Please retry or reload the page.". The issue started the day a Windows update was installed. It persisted in InPrivate mode, after clearing cookies, and on a different computer. Other users with similar profiles were not affected. The customer also saw a time zone warning on login.
root_cause: The platform failed to properly detect the browser's time zone and tried to use an invalid value, which caused the error. A Windows update had added new time zones, including the new Alberta time zone, and these broke Datadog's automatic time zone detection. This matched a known platform issue that had been escalated.
resolution_path: Support found an existing escalation matching the symptoms and the affected time zone.
Support asked whether a Windows update had been installed the previous day, and the customer confirmed one had.
Support offered workarounds: set an explicit time zone in Personal Settings > Preferences, or change the time zone of the Windows machine.
A platform-side fix was in progress. The customer later confirmed dashboards loaded again, the time zone warning was gone, and their preferences showed a time zone of America/Edmonton.
info_needed: Whether a Windows update was recently installed

qa_pairs.tse_question: Could you share a screenshot or screen capture that covers the behavior you're seeing?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: The customer sent screenshots of a dashboard that almost loads, a typical dashboard error, and the Metrics Explorer error.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Was a Windows update installed yesterday?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Yes, the device updated first thing that morning and its time zone changed to the new Alberta time zone. The customer had been seeing a time zone warning on login, and the new time zone was not available in Datadog.

evidence: Oops, an error has occurred. Please retry or reload the page.

tse_approach.summary: The support engineer asked for screenshots, then found an existing escalation matching the symptoms. They correlated it with a recent Windows update and gave a workaround while the platform fix was pending.
steps: Asked for a screenshot or screen capture of the behavior
Searched for similar reports and found a matching escalation about time zone detection
Asked whether a Windows update had been installed the day before
Explained the cause and offered two workarounds, noting a fix was in progress
Confirmed resolution with the customer and closed the ticket
